risks.advice: Activate frost protection immediately. Citrus trees suffer irreversible damage below 2°C.
Irrigate during early morning. Prolonged heat above 40°C causes fruit drop.
Cover plants at night. Tomatoes stop growing below 10°C.
Shade and increase irrigation. Pollen becomes non-viable above 35°C.
Monitor soil moisture. Frost on dry soil is more damaging than on moist soil.
Heat above 32°C during grain fill reduces yield significantly.
Tubers are damaged below 3°C. Hill up soil around plants for insulation.
Tuber formation stops above 30°C. Consider shade netting.
